review_text: January 31, 2026. Was here last January 17, 2025. The menu was the same as last year but some in the food menu were added and removed. Either way, consistent sila. Deserved to have a break. Last time, I had the ₱95 Doppio which was two shots of strong espresso. I had to walk from here all the way to Bago Oshiro and vice versa to burn my coffee. Ventured to enter at 11pm as said in Facebook post since they are reopening but saw the recent post that they are open by 10am so we got in. Very thankful that the cafe is as good as new but I will say better from before. Felt more homey. Also would like to thank the staff and owner for allowing us to take part in the blessing of the cafe reopening. ₱165 Iced White Mocha and ₱130 Cortado are great. Both did not feel palpitating. Thanks for having this on the house. May come back soon but looking forward to the coffee trainings or cuppings that were offered previous years. Update: The Cortado is 6oz in cup, not 8oz. Correction.

I've been here quite often. They're like your friendly neighborhood cafe. There are times the place is full of noisy people, but majority of the time the cafe's ambiance is light and relaxing. At the time we went there, sockets are not free to charge your devices and they only have 2-3 sockets available. The place is giving "for catch-up vibes" only. The food and coffee is goooood! Though some snacks are a bit overpriced for its quantity/quality (for example the pizza, which I don't recommend) other than that, the rest of the food menu is okay. Overall, it's still worth it to keep coming back.

Craft coffee shop boasts a charming and inviting atmosphere, characterized by rustic decor, soft lighting, and comfortable seating. However, I was somewhat disappointed by the overwhelming sweetness that dominated both the coffee and food offerings. While the ambiance was delightful, the coffee options leaned heavily towards sugary concoctions, neglecting the refined tastes of true coffee lovers who prefer a more balanced and nuanced experience. The menu lacked variety in savory options, focusing primarily on pastries and desserts. Despite these shortcomings, the coffee shop's ambiance remained inviting, and with some adjustments to reduce sugar levels and diversify the menu, it has the potential to become a go-to destination for coffee enthusiasts seeking a more refined experience.

This gorgeous coffee shop was a total and wonderful shock for us, that this gem is here in Mintal, maybe the absolute highlight of the district. We spent many years in Seoul where there are coffee shops on every corner, over 400 totally overrated Starbucks and thousands of other brands where the espresso is sometimes served in half litre paper cups! Coffee is something special and to be savoured in the proper way. Here in Craft you will taste the best coffee in Davao in a unique atmosphere. The staff are super friendly and the decor is overwhelmingly beautiful with extravagently thick and heavy quality wooden furnishings. This is a must visit coffee shop, best destination in Mintal !!!!

I think they can adjust their machines a little bit more, but the coffee is already at a high standard, some of best you can buy arround and in davao. You can not see the shop from the mainroad or other roads. Follow the link in Google maps. Only 1 (one) parking lot in the front, you need to put your car somewhere else. Only 2 things i recognice to improve: first the clocks. They have 3 fashionable clocks... and not a single one is showing the time.
